finding: Viewer members can mutate library folders

repo_fix.control: Component library folder create, rename, delete, and reorder server actions now call public.is_workspace_editor before any library_folders table access or reorder RPC write.

implemented_controls: Dropped the old all-action library_folders policy that allowed any workspace member to mutate folders.
Added a SELECT-only member policy so workspace viewers can still read library folders.
Added insert, update, and delete policies that require public.is_workspace_editor(workspace_id).
Replaced the reorder_library_folders RPC body so it rejects actors unless public.is_workspace_editor(target_workspace_id) is true.
Revoked all direct library_folders privileges from authenticated before granting back only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE.
Kept reorder_library_folders executable by authenticated users while blocking anon execution; the RPC now performs the editor check internally.
